name: Sanlorenzo S.p.A.
summary: Sanlorenzo S.p.A. designs, builds, and sells boats and pleasure boats in Italy, rest of Europe, the Asia-Pacific, the United States, the Middle East, and internationally. It operates through four divisions: Yacht, Superyacht, Bluegame, and Nautor Swan. The company provides maintenance and charter services for various vessels, as well as sells its new and pre-owned yachts. It also designs, manufactures, and markets motor, sport utility, and sailing yachts under the Sanlorenzo and Bluegame brands. The company was formerly known as Cantieri Navali San Lorenzo SpA and changed its name to Sanlorenzo S.p.A. in 2005. The company was founded in 1958 and is based in Ameglia, Italy.
